prompt: What are the statutory misdemeanor fines for violating the Texas statewide texting while driving ban?

options.text: Mandatory three thousand dollar civil forfeiture fine on all cell phone carriers
Permanent driver license revocation with zero administrative court hearing rights
Violations carry zero monetary fines and are resolved by written warning notices
Fines of $25 to $99 for first offense, and $100 to $200 for subsequent convictions
